backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two UI theme-related feature updates and their affected files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files across components, sections, hooks, and content.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and custom OKLCH CSS variables for light and dark themes with RTL-safe defaults.
frontend/index.html: Arabic RTL HTML entry point setting up the root container and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component that shows the intro splash once per session and otherwise renders layout, navigation, and content.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing background, footer, and the floating help‑bot panel around main app children.
frontend/src/components/DecoratedHeading: Section heading component with an icon and decorative gradient bar.
frontend/src/components/HelpBotPanel.tsx: Interactive help‑bot panel with search, suggested questions, and scroll‑to‑section support.
frontend/src/components/IntroSplash.tsx: Full‑screen intro splash with hero image, Arabic title text, and a CTA button to enter the site.
frontend/src/components/ProsConsCard.tsx: Displays pros and cons lists with icons and RTL‑friendly styling.
frontend/src/components/SimulatorPanel.t: Interactive simulator panel that renders input sliders and calculated outputs for a selected energy type.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with smooth scrolling and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/VideosGallery.ts: Displays videos grouped by energy type with fallback handling for failed embeds.
frontend/src/content/energyTypes.ts: Defines energy type metadata including names, icons, descriptions, pros, and cons.
frontend/src/content/helpBotQa.ar.ts: Arabic Q&A dataset covering energy, citizenship, and Algeria-specific topics for a help bot.
frontend/src/content/reportSections.ts: Structured content sections for the report, including headings, paragraphs, and lists.
frontend/src/content/videos.ts: Defines a Video interface and exports a list of three local MP4 video entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHelpBotSearch.ts: Implements simple keyword search over Arabic Q&A content with suggested questions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, stored identity loading, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for backend-related React Query hooks with no current functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionIntroGate.t: Controls visibility of an intro screen using sessionStorage to track whether it was previously seen.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining light/dark theme variables and RTL base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and mounts App.
frontend/src/sections/EnergyTypesSection: Interactive section letting users browse energy types, showing details and pros/cons.
frontend/src/sections/MainContent.tsx: Assembles the main page structure with report sections, energy types, simulators, and videos.
frontend/src/sections/ReportSection.tsx: Renders a report section with headings, paragraphs, and lists based on structured content blocks.
Provides an interactive simulator selector and displays the selected energy simulator panel.
frontend/src/sections/VideosSection.tsx: Renders the educational videos section with heading, description, and video gallery.
frontend/src/simulators/simulatorMath.ts: Defines output structure and provides calculation functions for each energy type, generating estimated energy, emissions, cost, and reliability values based on inputs.
Defines input model structures and returns predefined slider/input configurations for each energy type simulator.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins like typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s metadata, architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature records for the educational energy web app.
